segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently report the cream is non-irritating and soothing, though a few describe milia, burning, or reactions from it.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the cream is hydrating and helps flaky, tight under-eye patches, with one noting it reduced psoriasis-related dryness.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 50s and post-menopausal report reduced fine lines, creasing, and dark circles with continued use.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, crow's feet, and creasing, some within a week to a few weeks; one reviewer saw no improvement in fine lines despite skin feeling nourished.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating and long-lasting under the eyes, including for dry and dry-normal skin; one reviewer found it 'not hydrating' and thick without benefit.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with eczema, eczema-prone eyelids, or burning eye skin report the cream soothed irritation and reduced flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema or allergy-prone skin report the cream calmed and protected fragile under-eye skin without stinging.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the cream caused new milia around the eyes; others report existing milia shrank or disappeared with continued use, and one reviewer resumed use despite past milia concerns with no recurrence.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer explicitly warns against use for acne-prone skin due to burning and milia, though this is not a common thread among other reviewers.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the cream reduces dark circle appearance without leaving an oily residue; oiliness is not otherwise a common complaint.

aspects.libelle: Greasy feel if applied too close to eye

extraits.texte: unfortunately, this product caused little hard white bumps (millia) to form under my eyes. the applicator is nice but the cream is very thick and not hydrating. my undereyes would burn after using this if i applied any other products. do not recommend for sensitive and acne prone skin :(

I've gone through A LOT of eye creams and i gotta say this one hydrates my under eyes. I use morning and night and I have noticed the dry patch(psoriasis) under my left eye makes it go away. I have dry skin and do notice faintly it keeps it hydrated. For the price, ill keep using it because it does help a bit. The applicator, if using it correctly, only comes out a little; i haven't had any problems with a whole bunch coming out.

I'm 39 and I've been using this product for about five years. This is my forever repurchase eye cream. Since I was in highschool I've struggled with dark circles and creases below my eyes. I began using my Mom's All About Eyes Clinique samples but it didn't seem to make a difference. Over the next 25 years or so I tried every eye cream on the market but nothing seemed to make a difference. Some even caused stinging and milia which took a long time to reverse. Finally, I decided to try an affordable eye cream from a brand that focuses on being efficacious and gentle. I figured if eye creams don't make a difference I would at least try one that would not do damage. Enter Cocoking Revitalizing Eye Cream. This is the sleeper hit of the decade for me. The first thing I noticed was the way I would feel so relaxed after applying and gently massaging this cream into my temples and patting gently into my under eyes and slong my brow bone. This encouraged me to use it both morning and night. Over time i realized my dark circles were gone. I no longer use concealer. I also noticed my creases were gone and my eye area looks better than they did in my twenties. I've probably purchased about ten tubes and I will continue to repurchase. My 53 year old husband uses it too now and really enjoys it as well. He really likes the cooling applicator.

I stayed away from eye creams due to recurring milia, but this one changed my mind. It absorbs into the skin quickly and the metal tip applicator feels lovely. I have very sensitive skin around my eyes that tends to get eczema patches and this did not irritate my skin.

I have been using this for 2.5 weeks and have fallen in love with it. I am 39, been through menopause, and have dry-normal skin. My undereyes have been a nightmare with concealers because they're always so dry. I have tried about 5 or 6 different eye creams but they either dried my undereyes out even worse, burned, or pilled with my makeup. This is the first eye cream product that is thin enough to absorb quickly and leaves my undereyes HYDRATED all day. I have been testing it with my color correctors, concealers, and with just powder foundation. At the end of the day the undereyes still look phenomenal. A bonus is the cooling effect of the metal tip applicator. If you don't like the idea of that, the metal tip applicator comes off and you can get the product straight from the tube. I like to put a few dots under each eye and gently rub it in with the metal applicator. The coolness helps with my puffiness in the mornings. Then I go in and tap and gently rub in with my ring fingers. I couldn't ask for a better product and at a fair price point. I'm in love with Coco Kind!

extraits.titre: AMAZING for my eczema prone eyes
extraits.texte: I got this as part of a gift set and didn't think much of it at first, since personally I think most eye creams are just overpriced moisturizers. And I pretty much never write reviews. BUT. I swear to god this is the first winter in like 5 years where I did not have an eczema flare up on my eyelids. I actually started to flare up on one eye in the couple days before I started using it, and it WENT AWAY after using this a day or two. I was flabbergasted lol. I've been using it morning and night since and didn't have a single flare up after that. Idk what is in this that makes it different since I have tried a ton of different creams short of a prescription and none have helped like this. As far as helping fine lines go can't say I've seen much help there. But will 1000% keep buying if it means it keeps my itchy eyelids at bay!! Definitely recommend trying if you also have dry sensitive eyes!!

extraits.titre: Not meant for use under makeup
extraits.texte: I tried to use this eye cream in so many ways (using the applicator to spread and massage a thin veil, dabbing rather than rubbing, with my fingers, letting dry and dabbing before sunscreen…). Unfortunately it pills so badly that I can't use it during the day (even if I'm not wearing any makeup). It is annoying to wear, evan at night. I will nor re-purchase
